content: Statamic code fieldtype is CodeMirror with 25 languages; stores a string, or an array {code, mode} when mode_selectable is on; the docs tell you to print it inside <pre><code> and reach for Prism.js for highlighting, and to use unescaped output in Blade. Range fieldtype: min/max/step/append, stores an int or a float depending on those. Craft Time field: minute increment plus min/max, stored H:i, returns a DateTime with today's date or null.
